statistical_factor_model.model_specification: AR_t = sum_{i=1}^{K} lambda_i_t / sum_{j=1}^{N} lambda_j_t  where lambda_i_t are eigenvalues of rolling-window covariance matrix Sigma_{t-W:t-1}; eigendecomposition strictly t-1 close.
statistical_factor_model.estimation: rolling_eigendecomposition (no full-sample); Marchenko-Pastur cutoff optional for noise eigenvalue removal
statistical_factor_model.overlay_emission: scalar beta_t in [0, 1]; w_final_t = beta_t * w_STR1715_t (cash residual = 1 - beta_t)

mapping_specifications.linear_band: beta_t = clip(1 - (AR_t - AR_lo) / (AR_hi - AR_lo), 0, 1) where AR_lo/hi = expanding 30/85 percentile
mapping_specifications.threshold_step: beta_t = 1 if AR_t < AR_q70 else 0.7 if AR_t < AR_q90 else 0.4 (3 step)
mapping_specifications.sigmoid_smooth: beta_t = 1 / (1 + exp(k * (AR_t - AR_med))) with k tuned

statistical_factor_model.PIT_enforcement: AR_t computed strictly from t-1 close; beta_t applied at t open
